metadata.title: Styling polygon vector features
metadata.abstract: Basic vector features styling (polygons): land cover in Rondane, Norway (N50 Kartdata)

symbolizer.$comment:
Do not show Landcover layer by default
No default Dot at each polygon's centroid

nestedRules.$comment: Show land cover if zoomed in more than 1:200,000 for data valid within visualization's selected time range

symbolizer.$comment: Open land and the other classes: a light neutral fill through which the relief below shows

nestedRules.$comment: Select different fill and stroke color based on class property

symbolizer.$comment:
Change stroke width to 2 pixels
Add a text marker (positioned at centroid + horizontal offset) showing name property

nestedRules.$comment: Add icons at centroid based on land cover class property

metadata.title: Styling line vector features
metadata.abstract: Basic vector features styling (lines): roads in Sel, Norway (N50 Kartdata), colored by road class

symbolizer.$comment: No default Dot at each vertex

nestedRules.$comment: Select stroke color, width and drawing order based on the class property

symbolizer.$comment:
Change stroke width to 8 meters (12 meters for the main roads)
Add Dot at each segment end-point

metadata.title: Styling point vector features
metadata.abstract: Basic vector features styling (points): tourist cabins in Dørålen, Rondane, Norway (N50 Kartdata)

symbolizer.$comment: A small Dot (positioned at the point)
Replace it with a double-Dot marker (positioned at centroid)
Add a Text graphic to Marker at 1:5000

stylingRules.$comment:
A light tint over the context, a soft band along each boundary with a crisp line in its center,
